label: preparing
what: Likely a private jubilee gathering or celebration involving a substantial bread order and the great hall, timed around day 1 at 18:00. Innkeeper collected bread, owes the baker 44 emeralds payable after the jubilee, and arranged to escort me to the hall. Freight requested privacy until 18:00. Baker supplies the bread and builder's lighting inspection may help prepare the hall; whether either knows the full hidden purpose is uncertain. No clear evidence that secretary or neighbour knowingly participates.
